alignment: Linear interpolation of recorded aligned targets and native model outputs on the original local-position measurement clock; no extrapolation. Exact requested points outside either trajectory support are missing. Separately report supported_endpoint=min(500ms,lastA,lastB), without calling a shorter endpoint exact 500ms.
truth_anchor: Original Stage3 convention: each recorded increment uses its aligned TARGET origin; predictions and simple baselines use their common causal input initial state. Also report a causal-origin anchoring sensitivity.
aggregation: Each seed separately; pooled seeds average errors, not trajectories. Pair equal and equal flight/connected component weights; no confidence intervals or p values.
examples: Train main: lowest Control pooled p curve RMSE among response RMS>=0.1; worst Control-minus-Hold curve RMSE; largest absolute p endpoint bias. Include the only validation pair regardless of result.
test_policy: Sealed: never open test Parquet, test ULog or test prediction arrays.
